namingCollisionNote: The source archive numbers these axes D01-D12. The repository already uses 'D12' for an unrelated owner decision (the Knowledge Base architecture decision recorded in docs/DECISION_REGISTER.md). Per charter section IV these axes are addressed as KB-D01..KB-D12 everywhere in this workstream, while each record preserves sourceCompetencyId for traceability back to the archive. Repository decision D12 is untouched.

competencies.title: Safety, red flags, and escalation
competencies.note: Recognition/escalation/routing behaviour may be assessed from the record's own packet; any claim about a clinical threshold requires an external authority.

competencies.title: HIPAA, privacy, security, and minimum necessary
competencies.note: Charter section XVI: HIPAA is never reduced to 'never disclose'. Identity, authorization, permitted purpose, minimum necessary and channel safeguards are distinct, and each interpretation needs authority.
